title: If an exercise's details cannot be read when a workout starts, a timed or distance exercise shows as weight and reps
what: When a live workout starts, the phone reads how each exercise is logged. If that read fails, it quietly treats every exercise as weight and reps. A plank or a run then shows weight and reps boxes, its last numbers are shown wrongly, and what the member logs is saved the wrong way. Nothing is shown and no note is kept. The edit screen refuses to open in the same case, because the code itself says saving would drop timed sets.
expected: Retry the read, and if it still fails tell the member and keep a note, as the edit screen already does, instead of guessing weight and reps.
fix_line: Treat a failed read of how an exercise is logged as an error, not as weight and reps

title: Last time's numbers, the rest length, the carried note and record alerts can quietly go missing in a live workout
what: Starting a workout reads last time's sets, warm-ups, the previous workout's name, each exercise's rest length, the note carried over and the member's bests. Each of these reads, and the 'same routine' choice for Previous values, turns a failure into 'nothing' or 'all workouts' with no message and no note kept. The member sees empty Previous boxes, a default rest, no record alert, or numbers from another routine, and cannot tell anything went wrong.
expected: The workout should still start, but a note of each failed read should be kept and sent to MettleUp so a broken read is noticed.
fix_line: Keep a note of each failed read when a workout starts

title: Switching an exercise between kg each and as one can fail to save without a word
what: When the member switches how an exercise's weight is counted during a workout, the card changes at once, but saving that choice for the exercise happens in the background and any failure is thrown away. The next workout then uses the old counting, and the bests are not re-read in the new counting. The member is not told.
expected: A failed save of the counting should be tried again or shown to the member, and a note kept.
fix_line: Tell the member and keep a note when the counting choice cannot be saved

title: If the plan cannot be read when a routine starts, an easy week starts as a full workout
what: Starting a routine reads the followed plan to see if this is an easy week. If that read fails, the phone quietly treats it as a normal week and gives the full sets. The member does a full workout in a week meant to be lighter and is not told.
expected: A failed plan read should be retried or noted, not turned into a normal week without a word.
fix_line: Keep a note and retry when the plan cannot be read at start
